answer:
Top priority: your stool test (FIT) on 2025-11-04 was POSITIVE, and I can find no colonoscopy or other follow-up afterward. A positive FIT needs a colonoscopy, usually within a few months, so please raise this first; it is now about a year later.

Other things to discuss:
- Diabetes: your A1c improved from 8.3% (Jan 2025) to 6.9% (Feb 2026), but it has not been checked since February, so it is due. Metformin ended in April 2024; you now take Jardiance 10 mg. Ask whether that plan is still right.
- Cholesterol: in Feb 2025 your LDL was 131 and total cholesterol 212 (above target for someone with diabetes). Atorvastatin 20 mg was listed from 2025-02-20, but there is no cholesterol test since, so no check that it is working.
- Diabetes routine checks: I see no urine albumin test, eye exam, foot exam or any vaccination records. These may be held elsewhere; ask.
- Kidney function (eGFR 73 to 69) is normal but drifting down slightly; worth rechecking with Jardiance.
- July 2025 chest pain: the CT showed no pulmonary embolism and the chest wall pain resolved. Nothing to act on, though the CT noted mild spine degeneration.

I cannot see records held outside this system, so some items may simply be missing from it.
short: My 2025-11-04 FIT stool test was positive with no recorded colonoscopy since; also due: A1c (last Feb 2026), cholesterol recheck on atorvastatin (last Feb 2025), and diabetes screening (urine albumin, eye, foot) and vaccines not on file.
